message: Hi, I wanted to check in on invoice #1048 — it has been overdue for two weeks. Could you let me know when the payment will be sent?

I'm not sure I understood the requirements — could you clarify exactly what you need on the homepage?
I disagree with the last feedback — the design follows the brief we agreed on. Can we talk through what needs to change?
Your last message said the work was poor quality, but I've followed every spec. I'd like to understand what specifically didn't work.
My hourly rate for this project is $40 — I can't lower it further, but I'm happy to adjust the scope to fit your budget.
I need the final files today. This has been delayed twice already and our client is waiting.
